notes: Two data problems worth a look. (1) locke.json flags Soul Ignition (W) with trueDamage, and _missing-interactions built a 'bypasses stacking resistances' row on it — but Riot's text says the damage W deals is to HIMSELF, which he then partially heals back. I wrote no true-damage claim against the player and used only the heal, which the description does support. (2) The site calls his Q 'Ritual Nails' while Riot's text calls the projectiles 'Soul Nails', and the missing-interactions rows name his P/W/E as Silver Stake, Soul Ignition and Ashen Pursuit. packet.enemyAbilities is null for this champion so I could not confirm the Q's official name and left every 'Ritual Nails' string as-is rather than guess.
